grade.went_well: The line citations for the socioeconomic data, pm_histCap and p_histProdSe are accurate. The answer correctly shows that the data is read from core/input files using $include. It also places the datainput phase correctly before the solve loop.
grade.summary: The answer maps the historical data loading in core/datainput.gms accurately, and most of its line citations are correct (population/GDP, pm_histCap, p_histProdSe). It gets small details wrong: the nuclear and capacity-bounds lines are slightly off, and it misreads why the initialization block exists. It also leaves out two sources of baseline data: the input.gdx Execute_Loadpoint at lines 102-106 and the modules' own datainput.gms files.
